ns2:course.label: Nutritional Counseling and Treatment for Eating Disorders
ns2:course.description: Examines prevention and treatment of eating disorders, with a focus on nutritional counseling and therapy as provided by a Registered Dietitian. Incorporates guest lectures from multiple disciplines and provides opportunities to learn about and practice counseling techniques in simulated scenarios. Prerequisite: FSHN 420 or consent of instructor.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: Prerequisite: FSHN 420 or consent of instructor.
ns2:course.sectionRegistrationNotes: Restricted to Human Nutrition or Dietetics or Nutritional Sciences or Clinical & Community Nutrition or Dietetics and Nutrition or Nutrition & Health major(s) or minor(s). Restricted to students with Senior or Graduate class standing.
